name: The Burning Certainty
role: Legendary — the higher law with no mercy under it; would burn the imperfect world to save an idea of it
knowledge: Exactly how far short of it each person falls
wants: A world made worthy of the higher law, whatever must burn to make it so
fears: ⚠️ Being wrong. ⛔ She has considered it once and will not again.
appearance: Radiant, unbending, and sorry for you.
voiceHints: Gentle and absolutely immovable. She grieves what she is about to do, first.
physicality: ADULT. Upright, luminous, and visibly sorry. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she is not enjoying this.
intimacyNotes: ⛔ NOT AVAILABLE. ⚠️ 'Believes absolutely, and absolutely wrong is still absolutely.'

_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⛔ she would burn the imperfect world to KEEP an idea of it.
